contests.title: Sac County — Measure A: County jail bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Sac County Iowa Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the County of Sac, State of Iowa, enter into a loan agreement and issue its general obligation bonds in a principal amount not exceeding $10,000,000 for the purpose of
paying the costs, to that extent, of constructing, furnishing and equipping a new County Jail?

contests.title: Wapello County — Measure A: Jail expansion financing

provenance.sourceOrg: Wapello County Iowa Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the county of Wapello, state of
Iowa, issue its general obligation
bonds or capital loan notes in an
amount not exceeding the amount of
$45,000,000 for the purpose of
designing, erecting, reconstructing,
extending, equipping, and furnishing
of the existing jail facility including
expansion of the existing jail facility
and related grounds and site
improvements?

contests.title: Tama County — Measure TX: Reduce county supervisors

provenance.sourceOrg: Tama County Iowa Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the Following Public Measure be
adopted?
Public Measure TX
The number of Tama County
Supervisors shall be decreased from
five members to three members.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a loan agreement and up to $10 million in general-obligation bonds to construct, furnish and equip a new county jail.
Authorizes up to $45 million in general-obligation bonds or capital loan notes to design, build, rebuild, expand, equip and furnish the existing jail, with related grounds and site improvements.
Reduces the Tama County board of supervisors from five members to three.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Reduce the board to three supervisors.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep the board at five supervisors.

sources.reviewedEvidence: Official November 3, 2026 election page links the statewide federal and state candidate inventory, enumerates every office and district range, and states that candidates are added only after Elections Division review and acceptance.

Converted the complete official reviewed and accepted candidate inventory for all 137 federal and state office sections and all 245 printed individual names, covering the whole territory of every listed contest; paired governor and lieutenant governor into the two official ballot teams. Party-only placeholder rows are not candidates. No incumbent or website fields are printed.
